description: Results of trials on Model Predictive Control and Optimal Power Flow and Input Time Series is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Thomas Schwierz, Oleksii Molodchyk (Technical University of Dortmund). The given data contains the results from laboratory trials related to the paper "Optimizing Congestion Management andEnhancing Resilience in Low-Voltage Grids Using OPF and MPC Control Algorithms Through Edge Computing and IEC 61850 Standards" currently in publication in IEEE Access. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
